title: Nashville True Crime Walking Guided Tour
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the darker side of Nashville with Mr. E’s True Crime Tours, a riveting 2-hour walking experience that reveals the city’s most notorious crimes and unsolved mysteries. Guided by knowledgeable storytellers trained in Mr. E’s meticulous research, this tour dives into real-life cases that showcase Nashville's troubled past—no ghost tales here. Discover gripping stories behind political scandals, unsolved murders, and infamous betrayals, all backed by thorough investigation. Ideal for both true crime enthusiasts and curious newcomers, this tour promises a factual and engaging journey through Music City’s shadowy history.

- 2-hour walking tour exploring Nashville’s true crime history
- Learn about infamous crimes from knowledgeable guides
- Experience well-researched stories without gimmicks or ghost tales
- Perfect for both true crime lovers and newcomers to the genre
